title: CamB_Leaf_Control_repl1
source_name_ch1: CamB, leaf no.2, control conditions, replicate 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Drought stress treatment: Soil drought (3.65%, i.e. pF = 4.0) was applied to plants after the appearance of the 4th leaf and it was continued for 10 days. The substrate humidity was determined by monitoring pots weight. Plants grown in pots with 11% water content (pF = 2.8) were used as the control.
growth_protocol_ch1: Two barley genotypes were used for the study: a German semidwarf cultivar Maresi and a Syrian breeding line Cam/B1/CI08887//CI05761 (CamB), adapted to dry environments. Grains of both genotypes were sterilized and sown in the pots with a dimension of 37 x 15 x 14 cm (L x W x H). The pots were filled with a mixture of sandy loam and sand (7 : 2, w/w). Initially, 15 seedlings were placed in pots, and after germination, the number of plants was reduced to 10. At this time, the seedlings were transferred to an air-conditioned greenhouse, where the temperature was maintained at 20/17°C (day/night), with the light intensity of 520 µmol(photon)m-2s-2.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated using an RNeasy Plant Mini Kit (Qiagen) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. After isolation, RNA was purified using precipitation in 1M lithium chloride. Each RNA precipitate was dissolved in nuclease-free H2O. The yield and purity of the RNA was determined using a NanoDrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (NanoDrop Technologies). The integrity of the RNA was checked using denaturation agarose gel electrophoresis using pre-cast gels and FlashGel RNA System (Lonza, Basel, Switzerland).
label_protocol_ch1: Cyanine-3 (Cy3) labeled cRNA was prepared from 100 ng of RNA using the the Agilent Low Input Quick Amp Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions, followed by Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit column purification (QIAGEN, Valencia, CA).  Dye incorporation and cRNA yield were checked with the NanoDrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer.
hyb_protocol: 55 µl of 2x the GE Hybridization mix (Agilent GE Hybridization Kit) was added to the fragmented cRNA and 110 was loaded onto the Agilent 4x44k Barley Array within a gasket array slide sandwich. Arrays were hybridised in a rotisserie hybridisation oven at 65°C for 17 hours (Agilent p/n G2545a Hybridization Oven). After 17 hours, the slides were removed from the oven and washed with Agilent Wash Buffers containing Triton X.
scan_protocol: After the wash, the slides were taken to be scanned on an Agilent High Resolution Scanner using the green dye channel at a resolution of a 5 µm single pass scan with no extended dynamic range.
description: K_Cam_L_c_01,Gene expression in leaf of CamB barley breeding line in control conditions
data_processing: Scanned images were analysed using Agilent Feature extraction software version 10.7.3.1.

treatment_protocol_ch1: Drought stress treatment: Soil drought (3.65%, i.e. pF = 4.0) was applied to plants after the appearance of the 4th leaf and it was continued for 10 days. The substrate humidity was determined by monitoring pots weight. Plants grown in pots with 11% water content (pF = 2.8) were used as the control.
growth_protocol_ch1: Two barley genotypes were used for the study: a German semidwarf cultivar Maresi and a Syrian breeding line Cam/B1/CI08887//CI05761 (CamB), adapted to dry environments. Grains of both genotypes were sterilized and sown in the pots with a dimension of 37 x 15 x 14 cm (L x W x H). The pots were filled with a mixture of sandy loam and sand (7 : 2, w/w). Initially, 15 seedlings were placed in pots, and after germination, the number of plants was reduced to 10. At this time, the seedlings were transferred to an air-conditioned greenhouse, where the temperature was maintained at 20/17°C (day/night), with the light intensity of 520 µmol(photon)m-2s-2.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated using an RNeasy Plant Mini Kit (Qiagen) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. After isolation, RNA was purified using precipitation in 1M lithium chloride. Each RNA precipitate was dissolved in nuclease-free H2O. The yield and purity of the RNA was determined using a NanoDrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (NanoDrop Technologies). The integrity of the RNA was checked using denaturation agarose gel electrophoresis using pre-cast gels and FlashGel RNA System (Lonza, Basel, Switzerland).
label_protocol_ch1: Cyanine-3 (Cy3) labeled cRNA was prepared from 100 ng of RNA using the the Agilent Low Input Quick Amp Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions, followed by Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit column purification (QIAGEN, Valencia, CA).  Dye incorporation and cRNA yield were checked with the NanoDrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer.
hyb_protocol: 55 µl of 2x the GE Hybridization mix (Agilent GE Hybridization Kit) was added to the fragmented cRNA and 110 was loaded onto the Agilent 4x44k Barley Array within a gasket array slide sandwich. Arrays were hybridised in a rotisserie hybridisation oven at 65°C for 17 hours (Agilent p/n G2545a Hybridization Oven). After 17 hours, the slides were removed from the oven and washed with Agilent Wash Buffers containing Triton X.
scan_protocol: After the wash, the slides were taken to be scanned on an Agilent High Resolution Scanner using the green dye channel at a resolution of a 5 µm single pass scan with no extended dynamic range.
description: K_Cam_R_d_12,Gene expression in roots of CamB barley breeding line in drought stress
data_processing: Scanned images were analysed using Agilent Feature extraction software version 10.7.3.1.

treatment_protocol_ch1: Drought stress treatment: Soil drought (3.65%, i.e. pF = 4.0) was applied to plants after the appearance of the 4th leaf and it was continued for 10 days. The substrate humidity was determined by monitoring pots weight. Plants grown in pots with 11% water content (pF = 2.8) were used as the control.
growth_protocol_ch1: Two barley genotypes were used for the study: a German semidwarf cultivar Maresi and a Syrian breeding line Cam/B1/CI08887//CI05761 (CamB), adapted to dry environments. Grains of both genotypes were sterilized and sown in the pots with a dimension of 37 x 15 x 14 cm (L x W x H). The pots were filled with a mixture of sandy loam and sand (7 : 2, w/w). Initially, 15 seedlings were placed in pots, and after germination, the number of plants was reduced to 10. At this time, the seedlings were transferred to an air-conditioned greenhouse, where the temperature was maintained at 20/17°C (day/night), with the light intensity of 520 µmol(photon)m-2s-2.
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was isolated using an RNeasy Plant Mini Kit (Qiagen) according to the manufacturer’s instructions. After isolation, RNA was purified using precipitation in 1M lithium chloride. Each RNA precipitate was dissolved in nuclease-free H2O. The yield and purity of the RNA was determined using a NanoDrop ND-1000 spectrophotometer (NanoDrop Technologies). The integrity of the RNA was checked using denaturation agarose gel electrophoresis using pre-cast gels and FlashGel RNA System (Lonza, Basel, Switzerland).
label_protocol_ch1: Cyanine-3 (Cy3) labeled cRNA was prepared from 100 ng of RNA using the the Agilent Low Input Quick Amp Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions, followed by Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit column purification (QIAGEN, Valencia, CA).  Dye incorporation and cRNA yield were checked with the NanoDrop ND-1000 Spectrophotometer.
hyb_protocol: 55 µl of 2x the GE Hybridization mix (Agilent GE Hybridization Kit) was added to the fragmented cRNA and 110 was loaded onto the Agilent 4x44k Barley Array within a gasket array slide sandwich. Arrays were hybridised in a rotisserie hybridisation oven at 65°C for 17 hours (Agilent p/n G2545a Hybridization Oven). After 17 hours, the slides were removed from the oven and washed with Agilent Wash Buffers containing Triton X.
scan_protocol: After the wash, the slides were taken to be scanned on an Agilent High Resolution Scanner using the green dye channel at a resolution of a 5 µm single pass scan with no extended dynamic range.
description: K_Mar_R_d_23,Gene expression in roots of Maresi barley cultivar in drought stress
data_processing: Scanned images were analysed using Agilent Feature extraction software version 10.7.3.1.
